method: New team-by-team season lineup collection from BDFutbol, researched independently of the pre-existing 148-player shortlist. Not a reuse, rewrite, approval, or merger of prior candidate data. Source group 'representative XI' is not a guaranteed real fixed match XI. Position hypotheses must be checked against historical match-by-match roles.
limits: No historical three-season corroboration for each person is claimed.
No new player tiers or per-position rank is issued before evidence review.
Some 0-league-start historical names were removed entirely from this source pool, not asserted ineligible for non-league cup participation.
A few roster players have approximate names/identity and season role hypotheses, requiring manual verification.
Different clubs do not share an assumed formation; individual formation review is pending.
Existing main data/laliga-1999-00.json and prior 148 provisional tiers/ranks remain untouched.
No browser test was carried out.
